about_the_game:
Step into the world of Ancient Farm Demo - a hands-on preview of life as an ambitious farmer in the heart of an ancient civilization.

Your journey begins with nothing but wild land, simple tools, and big dreams of turning your first harvest into riches. Prepare the soil, plant seasonal crops like carrots, grapes, coffee, and wheat, and care for your animals - cows, chickens, and your trusty ox, ready to help you plow the fields.

You won’t be left guessing what to do next. With 43 guided challenges, you’ll learn how to build a thriving farm. Every task brings you closer to mastering ancient agriculture, from preparing the ground and planting your first seeds to watering, fertilizing, and harvesting. You’ll raise livestock, gather resources like wood and clay, and craft essential buildings like workshops, barns, and shelters.

Once you’ve got the basics down, it’s time to scale up. Harness the power of your ox to plow larger fields and boost your production. Every challenge you complete expands your farm and sharpens your skills, preparing you for what lies beyond this demo.

What’s included in this demo:

  • Season-based farming with 6 plant types

  • Animal care with cows, chickens, and oxen

  • Resource gathering with tools and exploration

  • Building and crafting with workshops, barns, and farm structures

  • 43 guided challenges introducing all core mechanics

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Take on the role of an ancient farmer and build your farm from scratch by growing crops, raising animals, gathering resources, and mastering the challenges of ancient agriculture in this playable demo.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
